==Location and Uses==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Descriptions OoT}}
In {{OoT}}, the Zora Tunic allows [[Link]] to breathe [[Water (Terrain)|underwater]].<ref name="OoT N/A"/> It is mostly used in conjunction with the [[Iron Boots]] and is essential when exploring the [[Water Temple (Ocarina of Time)|Water Temple]]. Unlike the [[Goron Tunic]], it does not offer any defense bonuses. The Tunic can be stolen by a [[Like Like]] if Link is still wearing it when he gets spit out.

The Tunic can be bought at the [[Zora Shop]] for 300 [[Rupee]]s, or it can be given to Link by the [[King Zora]] when he unfreezes him from the [[Red Ice]] using [[Blue Fire]].<ref name="OoT King Zora"/>

The Zora Tunic is made out of fish gills,<ref name="OoT Nintendo 78"/> although aesthetically it looks completely identical to the other tunics in the game, with color being the only difference. The [[Zora]] supplied several Zora Tunics in service of the [[King of Hyrule]]'s [[Hylian]] water inspectors to help them clean the bed of [[Zora's River]].<ref name="OoT Nintendo 78"/>

==={{TP|-}}===
In {{TP}}, the Zora Armor is given to [[Link]] by [[Rutela]] after delivering [[Ralis]] to [[Kakariko Village]] safely. It is located behind the [[Kakariko Village Graveyard]] under the tomb of the [[King Zora]], its creator.<ref name="TP Rutela"/><ref name="TP Rutela 2"/>

When equipped, the Zora Armor allows Link to breathe and swim [[Water (Terrain)|underwater]].<ref name="TP Rutela 3"/> If combined with the [[Iron Boots]], Link can walk deep on riverbeds. However, wearing the armor makes Link take 10 times the damage from [[Fire]] and [[Ice]] attacks.<ref name="TP N/A"/> (Including falling in [[Lava]] or freezing Water)

The Zora Armor itself is made of [[Zora]] scales in a scale mail arrangement,{{Fact|TPHD}} and includes a mask that Link pulls over his face while underwater.

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Descriptions BotW}}
In {{BotW}}, the Zora Armor was hand crafted specifically for Link as a symbol of love by the [[Zora]] princess and [[Champion]], [[Mipha]].<ref name="BotW Sidon"/><ref name="BotW Muzu"/> Link receives it from [[King Dorephan]] 100 years later when first visiting [[Zora's Domain]]. If Link's pouch is full, he will receive it after making space in the inventory.<ref name="BotW King Dorephan"/>

When worn, the Zora Armor provides one level of [[Swim Speed Up]] and grants Link the ability to [[Swim Up Waterfalls]].<ref name="BotW Inventory"/> The Armor can be enhanced by a [[Great Fairy]] and can be [[Dye]]d at the [[Kochi Dye Shop]]. The Zora Armor, alongside the [[Zora Helm]] and the [[Zora Greaves]], compose the [[Zora Set]]. When each piece of the Set has been enhanced at least two times by a Great Fairy and the full Set is worn, it provides the [[Swim Dash Stamina Up]] [[Set Bonus]]. Unlike most armor, however, this Set cannot be sold due to the Armor's unique story behind it.

The Armor itself consists of a large full breastplate, a set of scale mail covering the shoulders and part of Link's back, two pauldrons made from steel, and bracers made from a combination of silver and steel plates.
